status: PARTIAL — BF547 settings diagnostic proven; prior sender candidate rejected

proven.interpretation: BF547 independently treats settings byte +4 as a meaningful processing-mode selector

correction.previous_hypothesis: possible SportNet command-7 sender because constants 37 and 7 occur in one frame
correction.rejected_because: 0x471c4 passes R2=7 into 0x6c3dc; 0x6c3dc immediately range-checks R2 against 13 and jump-dispatches on it, proving R2 is a generic serializer/type selector in that API. The 37 constant is another serializer argument, not sufficient evidence of SportNet command framing.
correction.consequence: Do not use 0x471c4 as sender evidence. Trace actual caller/dataflow of the BF547 settings object instead.

next: RBCLOSURE5AB: trace direct and pointer-table callers of 0x4c940, identify its settings object producer, then follow that object into the real SportNet send path.
